ideas.pitch: An AI-powered smart waste classification and reward system designed for hill stations like Dehradun to tackle tourist littering.
ideas.title: HimalayanEcoSort
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 'Best Social Welfare Project' special award and fits local Uttarakhand environmental challenges that offline judges in Dehradun will instantly recognize.

ideas.pitch: An open-source AI agent designed to automate repository maintenance, issue triage, and PR reviews for budding open-source maintainers.
ideas.title: OpenDevAssist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted specifically at the 'Best Open Source Project' award while directly supporting CodeSprint's core mission of forcing every MVP to be open-sourced.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-polished, frictionless collaborative grading and assignment review dashboard built with extreme attention to accessibility and micro-interactions.
ideas.title: GradeSync UI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aims squarely at the 'Best UI/UX' special award by focusing heavily on design systems, fluid animations, and zero-latency user flows during the live presentation.

ideas.pitch: A beginner-friendly platform connecting university students with mentors, featuring automated roadmap generation and milestone tracking.
ideas.title: PeerMentor Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimized to win the 'Best Beginner Team' award by demonstrating clean architecture, solid documentation, and extreme ease of onboarding for novice developers.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight supply chain transparency tool for local farmers in Uttarakhand to track agricultural produce from farm to local markets.
ideas.title: AgriTrace Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a novel regional use-case with clean execution to capture the 'Best Innovation' special award from the judging panel.
